title: Todd Monken: We won't play most starters against Bills if joint practice goes well

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken: We won't play most starters against Bills if joint practice goes well
sources.description: Shedeur Sanders will get the start at quarterback against the Bills in the Browns' second preseason game, but he may not have many other first-stringers in the lineup with him.
